messages:
Noah: FYI seeing a repeat of GPU attach failures in us-central during 03:00-04:00, looks IO-related.
Ingrid: Yep, pods stuck as WaitingForDiskBind, attach RPCs timing out.
OpsBot: alert: node_io.wait > 80% gnode-usc-42 at 2026-03-20T03:05:12Z :warning:
Pete: Pulled metrics and dmesg from the host, sustained write bursts from janitor scrub.
Noah: iostat snippet i pulled:
```
Device: rrqm/s wrqm/s r/s w/s rkB/s wkB/s avgrq-sz avgqu-sz await svctm %util
nvme0n1 0.00 120.00 1.00 820.00 8.00 64000.00 150.00 14.2 24.8 0.18 88.3
```
Ingrid: Matches the scrub-controller rollout yesterday. We bumped validation parallelism 4->16 to clear backlog.
Maya: That cleared backlog but created a noisy-neighbor write storm during peak provisioning. We need a throttle.
Pete: Short-term plan:
- rollback scrub parallelism to 2 for us-central
- add per-node IOPS throttle for janitor containers (io cgroups)
- shift deep-validate to sampled/off-peak
Noah: Also add an alert on node nvme %util > 70 that triggers a canary failover for GPU attaches.
SRE-Oncall: Patching scrub-controller to set `--max-concurrency=2` for rollout group us-central. Canarying on 3 nodes now.
EngBot: deploy started: scrub-controller v3.9.1 -> v3.9.1-patch-20260320 (rollout id: a1b2c3) :gear:
Ingrid: Quick smoke: watch avgqu-sz and %util on nvme. If attach errors persist we can route provisioning to eu-west.
Pete: Longer-term proposals:
- dedicate scratchpool hosts for janitor/validation workloads (isolate from gpu-pool)
- or enforce container-level blkio/io.max via kubernetes or cgroups
Maya: Cost estimate for dedicated scratchpool: ~ $0.17/hr per host in us-central. Compare vs lost GPU revenue during attach collapse.
Noah: Design idea: sampled-scrub mode -> full-validate 1% of volumes/day, quick-check remainder to cut write amplification 10x.
SRE-Oncall: Canary metrics look promising: nvme %util on canary nodes down from ~90 to ~45. Monitoring for 30m.
OpsBot: incident INC-20260320-scrub-noisy-neighbor created and assigned to @storage @infra-ops.
Maya: please add a ledger entry for lost GPU-hours vs scratchpool cost; need concrete numbers for the postmortem.
Pete: I'll draft cost calc and runbook after 30m green. Will include step-by-step rollback, throttle knobs, and `kubectl` commands.
Noah: Example check for override in cluster-admin:
```
kubectl -n infra get deploy scrub-controller -o yaml | yq '.spec.template.spec.containers[0].args'
# expect --max-concurrency=2 for us-central overrides
```
SRE-Oncall: Region rollout complete and metrics stable. Will follow up with writeup and backfill runbook.
